# Bubbleverse start commands

Base snapshot: `24f380ba4bc0129ac3bfcd1dcb105c597191b47a`. Canonical human launch registry; detailed machine-readable commands and workflow job blocks: [start_catalog.json](docs/cleanup/start_catalog.json).

All commands below are documentation, not instructions to dispatch another campaign. Work from the repository root for local commands. ACTIVE records preserve the registry status; they do not certify scientific acceptance or justify rerunning completed work. HISTORICAL records remain for reproducibility. BLOCKED templates require their target environment, inputs or a historical gate repair.

`${REQUIRED_ARGUMENTS[@]}` is a **Bash array** containing the exact required flags, positional modes and values listed in the CLI schema and corresponding workflow. Unset variables are not valid scientific input. `${NAME_REQUIRED}` placeholders likewise need deliberate values. Scripts with subparsers must use a listed subcommand. No secret values are included.

Quick checks:

```bash
python tools/check_repository_layout.py
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python -m unittest -v q048_inputcheck_tests_v1
python q048_package_check_v1.py
```

Q048 bounded offline replay after obtaining the twenty pinned metadata files:

```bash
python q048_inputcheck_v1.py --input-root "$Q047_RECONSTRUCTED_INPUT_DIR" --output "$NEW_Q048_RECEIPT_PATH"
```

The output path must be new. Missing or changed inputs fail the gate. No native computation is launched.

Setup: no root requirements.txt, pyproject.toml or installable package is declared. Q048/Q047 arithmetic checks use Python 3.12 standard library. Older workflows specify their own pinned environments and setup scripts. Reproduce each workflow environment; do not install every historical requirements file into one environment.

Source: [action.yml](action.yml)


Retry same-run actions/download-artifact transport failures without changing scientific state.

Working directory: Calling GitHub job.


No standalone executable command: Composite action, not a standalone shell command. Invoke only through a reviewed workflow.


CLI arguments / dispatch inputs:

```json
{
  "name": {
    "description": "Exact artifact name; leave empty when pattern is used.",
    "required": "false",
    "default": ""
  },
  "pattern": {
    "description": "Artifact pattern; leave empty when name is used.",
    "required": "false",
    "default": ""
  },
  "path": {
    "description": "Destination path.",
    "required": "true"
  },
  "merge-multiple": {
    "description": "Pass-through merge-multiple setting.",
    "required": "false",
    "default": "false"
  }
}
```


Configuration / callers:

```json
{
  "using": "composite",
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "attempt1",
      "continue-on-error": "true",
      "uses": "actions/download-artifact@v4",
      "with": {
        "name": "${{ inputs.name }}",
        "pattern": "${{ inputs.pattern }}",
        "path": "${{ inputs.path }}",
        "merge-multiple": "${{ inputs.merge-multiple }}"
      }
    },
    {
      "if": "steps.attempt1.outcome != 'success'",
      "shell": "bash",
      "run": "rm -rf \"${{ inputs.path }}\"\nsleep 5\n"
    },
    {
      "id": "attempt2",
      "if": "steps.attempt1.outcome != 'success'",
      "continue-on-error": "true",
      "uses": "actions/download-artifact@v4",
      "with": {
        "name": "${{ inputs.name }}",
        "pattern": "${{ inputs.pattern }}",
        "path": "${{ inputs.path }}",
        "merge-multiple": "${{ inputs.merge-multiple }}"
      }
    },
    {
      "if": "steps.attempt1.outcome != 'success' && steps.attempt2.outcome != 'success'",
      "shell": "bash",
      "run": "rm -rf \"${{ inputs.path }}\"\nsleep 15\n"
    },
    {
      "id": "attempt3",
      "if": "steps.attempt1.outcome != 'success' && steps.attempt2.outcome != 'success'",
      "continue-on-error": "true",
      "uses": "actions/download-artifact@v4",
      "with": {
        "name": "${{ inputs.name }}",
        "pattern": "${{ inputs.pattern }}",
        "path": "${{ inputs.path }}",
        "merge-multiple": "${{ inputs.merge-multiple }}"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "Artifact transport gate",
      "shell": "bash",
      "env": {
        "A1": "${{ steps.attempt1.outcome }}",
        "A2": "${{ steps.attempt2.outcome }}",
        "A3": "${{ steps.attempt3.outcome }}"
      },
      "run": "set -euo pipefail\nif [[ \"$A1\" != success && \"$A2\" != success && \"$A3\" != success ]]; then\n  echo \"Q040_SAME_RUN_ARTIFACT_TRANSPORT_GATE=FAIL name=${{ inputs.name }} pattern=${{ inputs.pattern }}\" >&2\n  exit 1\nfi\ntest -d \"${{ inputs.path }}\"\nif ! find \"${{ inputs.path }}\" -mindepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then\n  echo \"Q040_SAME_RUN_ARTIFACT_CONTENT_GATE=FAIL path=${{ inputs.path }}\" >&2\n  exit 1\nfi\necho \"Q040_SAME_RUN_ARTIFACT_TRANSPORT_GATE=PASS name=${{ inputs.name }} pattern=${{ inputs.pattern }}\"\n"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Cleanup installation workflow

Source: [.github/workflows/apply-bubbleverse-cleanup.yml](.github/workflows/apply-bubbleverse-cleanup.yml)

Upload the patch, then choose preview or apply. Apply creates a branch/PR; merge is manual.

